seo.title: Passion Fruit (Chinola) | Kibay Sparkling
seo.description: Explore the exotic world of Passion Fruit (Chinola). Learn about its health benefits, nutrients, and why it's the soul of Kibay's sparkling wine.

hero.title: Exotic
hero.tagline: Known locally as "Chinola," this tangy treasure is the heartbeat of Caribbean flavor.

characteristics.heading: Characteristics
characteristics.body: Tart, aromatic, and juicy; typically has a wrinkled purple or yellow rind. The unmistakable scent of passion fruit fills the air as soon as you cut it open, revealing golden, seed-filled pulp that bursts with flavor.

origins.heading: Origins & History
origins.body: Passion fruit is native to South America and is widely used in tropical cuisines. In the Dominican Republic, "Chinola" is more than a fruit—it's a staple ingredient for juices, desserts, and now, our premium sparkling wine.

health.title: Health Benefits
health.body: Passion fruit is known for its high antioxidant content, helps improve digestion, and supports heart health. Its seeds are also a great source of fiber.

vitamins.title: Vitamins & Nutrients
vitamins.body: Rich in Vitamin C, Vitamin A, and dietary fiber. It provides an immune-boosting punch of nutrition in every serving, making it as healthy as it is delicious.

cta.heading: Taste the Passion
cta.body: Experience the bold, refreshing zest of Chinola in our sparkling wine.
